Calculation Methodology

Extra Monthly Conversions = Visitors × (New CR% - Current CR%). Annual Revenue Lift = Extra Monthly Conversions × Customer Value × 12.

Reference Notes & FAQ

Why is Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) higher leverage than buying more ads?

Increasing conversion rate from 2.0% to 2.6% (+30% relative lift) increases revenue by 30% without spending an extra dollar on traffic.
